capabilities: Chat with vault notes using an AI agent with tool use
Create, edit, search, read, rename, and delete .md, .base, and .canvas files
Create and edit CSS snippets from natural-language chat requests
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in AI agent that can act on the vault (files, folders, snippets) from a chat interface without external tools.

requires.name: LM Studio or Ollama for local models

summary: Agentic AI chat plugin that searches, reads, creates, edits, renames, and deletes vault files and folders through tool use.
